The primary form observed is the LEGITIMATE one - price advanced AWAY from the fixed stop, so risk GREW 6.08 -> 6.80 points while reward shrank 11.20 -> 10.48, and chasing it would mean widening risk to hold the same target. Had this check acted on its first quote it would have taken a trade its next three quotes all refuse. The number is not stable and is not information; the L-004 and L-005 refusals are independent of it. Tenth consecutive material check; clock stays at ZERO.

execution_check.verdict: NOT ONE OF THE FIVE CONTRACTS HELD BOTH SIDES QUOTED ACROSS ALL FIVE SAMPLES. Ninth consecutive check. BNBUSDT is the BINDING one because a long BUYS INTO THE ASK: its ask printed 7.67 USDT (0.01 BNB) at sample 4, so a maximum 2,500 USDT market buy is 326x the entire visible ask, and it printed that at 0.522 bps. BNB had held both sides across samples 1-3 and was the ONLY contract to do so - three healthy samples again meant nothing, which is the lesson's core claim. Its bid then fell 4,973,531 -> 39,979 USDT, 124x, between samples 3 and 5. XRPUSDT is the strongest PERSISTENCE instance of the experiment: bid unquoted on FOUR CONSECUTIVE samples (267.47 / 247.07 / 247.17 / 22.29 USDT), a book that never returned inside the check rather than a collapse-and-recover. BTCUSDT was gone on the ask at THREE of five (84.20 / 70,831 / 33.70 USDT) while quoting 0.012 bps at sample 4 - the tightest spread of the check on a 70k then 34 dollar ask - and its bid collapsed 24,070,823 -> 244,485 USDT in 78 seconds. SOLUSDT was unquoted on BOTH sides at sample 5 (bid 19.42, ask 51.42). ETHUSDT's ask printed 29.31 USDT at 0.60 bps at sample 2, the same pathology as the 00:00 check but on the OPPOSITE side - ETH has now been caught unquoted on the bid (00:00, five of five) and on the ask (this check). No contract breached the 25 bps cap this check; the cap is again blind to all of it.
